guide.summary: Linear documents OAuth2 for applications that integrate with Linear for others to use. The read-issue-titles action can use the default read scope, which the sources describe as always present and granting read access to the user's account. Pagination uses first/after cursors and continues while pageInfo.hasNextPage is true. Write scopes such as issues:create are not requested. Workspace admin requirements in the sources are tied to actor=app installations, not to standard user OAuth. Whether a directory listing or other distribution review applies to this non-agent customer OAuth app is not established by the supplied sources.

evidence.quote: ### Example ```http GET https://linear.app/oauth/authorize?response_type=code&client_id=YOUR_CLIENT_ID&redirect_uri=YOUR_REDIRECT_URL&state=SECURE_RANDOM&scope=read HTTP/1.1
